title: Marvel's Wolverine Reveals Brutal Combat, Mutant Abilities and New Gameplay Details
summary: Insomniac Games' Marvel's Wolverine brings brutal claw combat, mutant abilities and a darker superhero story to PlayStation 5.
content:
Marvel's Wolverine is an upcoming action game from Insomniac Games, the studio behind Marvel's Spider-Man. The game puts players in control of Logan, a mutant known for his adamantium claws, extraordinary healing factor and aggressive fighting style.

Combat is at the center of the experience. Wolverine uses his claws for fast, powerful close-range attacks against enemies. His strength and resilience allow him to fight through dangerous encounters, while his healing factor reflects one of the character's most recognizable abilities.

Logan's enhanced senses also help him investigate locations and track threats. These abilities connect exploration with combat and give players different ways to approach dangerous situations throughout the adventure.

The story explores Wolverine's mysterious past and the difficult choices connected to his identity. As Logan searches for answers, he encounters dangerous enemies and characters from the wider Marvel universe. The game's darker tone aims to reflect the character's violent reputation and personal struggles.

Insomniac Games is developing Marvel's Wolverine for PlayStation 5. The project is separate from the studio's Spider-Man games, offering a different style of action built around Logan's claws, strength and mutant abilities.

Players should follow official PlayStation announcements for confirmed gameplay footage, release information and additional details as development progresses.
